predecessor_rule: predecessor_release_row_id is release lineage and MUST NOT be converted into supersession
alias_rule: aliases are asserted only from explicit accepted evidence such as PREVIOUS_ID_TAXON_JBLR; a name match is never sufficient
supersession_rule: supersession/replacement requires explicit accepted relation evidence, distinct existing concept IDs, reason and provenance
current_release_zero_relation_semantics: zero explicit aliases or supersessions means no such relation is asserted by RC3; it does not mean external absence
